# AAM Reality Index (SMG Consulting)

Source: https://aamrealityindex.com/aam-reality-index (Infogram embeds `_/mLOZQq2YiEtJW2aX6Tko` ARI,
`_/hk6I65D3sRfrprpa1ncC` AAM FUNDING, `_/gGdLjJdj4C80r7FhnROY` ARI HISTORY), fetched 2026-09-22.
The index scores OEMs 0-10 on funding, team, technology readiness, certification progress and
production readiness. Public data, © SMG Consulting; used here for a firm-level comparison only.

- `ari_may2026.csv` — the May 2026 release (score, funding, use case, vehicle type, propulsion, operation)
- `ari_funding_may2026.csv` — disclosed funding per OEM, $M
- `ari_history.csv` — score per release, December 2020 to May 2026
- `ari_company_map.csv` — OEM name -> canonical company of the patent corpus (hand-made)
